items.title: Walmart (WMT) Agrees To $7.8 Million Pennsylvania Child Labor Settlement
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) agreed to pay a record $7.8 million child labor settlement in Pennsylvania following state investigations. Pennsylvania authorities found widespread violations of the state's Child Labor Act across Walmart locations, according to the settlement announcement. The agreement requires Walmart to adopt enhanced child labor compliance measures and includes higher future penalty provisions for any new violations.
